_comment: Copy to nights.json. _open_days = weekdays that count as open nights; reports on weekdays that are neither MAIN_RAID_DAYS nor open days are skipped (OPEN_RAID_DAYS in .env overrides this list). _include = report codes to always add to the dataset (e.g. a log not on the guild page). _ignore = codes to leave out. Other keys override the detection: a report code or a date (YYYY-MM-DD) -> 'main', 'open' or 'skip'.
